title: OpenAI GPT-4.5 System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型系统卡与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计前沿模型报告中的阶段级披露，以及阻碍独立复核训练数据、反馈、奖励和谱系的缺失工件
one_line: OpenAI's GPT-4.5 system card discloses broad public/partnership/in-house data categories, smaller-model-derived alignment data, SFT, RLHF, filtering, and selected safety evaluation protocols, but not reproducible data or feedback contracts.
OpenAI 的 GPT-4.5 系统卡披露了宽泛的公开/合作/内部数据类别、来自小模型的对齐数据、SFT、RLHF、过滤及部分安全评测协议，但没有公开可复现的数据或反馈契约。
why: It is a central Track 12 comparison point: the report offers meaningful stage-level and safety-evaluation disclosure, yet makes visible which missing artifacts prevent independent audit of source provenance, post-training feedback, reward mechanisms, filtering, and lineage.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact frontier system card that names public, partnership, and in-house data categories plus smaller-model-derived alignment data, SFT, RLHF, filtering, and selected evaluation contracts while leaving record-level data, feedback, reward, and recipe details undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
System cards may name data categories and post-training method families while withholding the concrete records and feedback contracts needed to verify provenance, reproduce learning, or audit safety claims. This gap matters because evaluation infrastructure can be richly described without being training infrastructure.

The GPT-4.5 report is useful as a Track 12 disclosure ledger: it offers meaningful stage-level statements about data, scalable alignment, SFT, RLHF, filtering, and safety assessment, while retaining the underlying data and optimization details.

系统卡可以点名数据类别和后训练方法家族，却不公开验证数据来源、复现学习过程或审计安全主张所需的具体记录与反馈契约。这一缺口尤其重要，因为评测基础设施可以被详细描述，但并不等同于训练基础设施。

GPT-4.5 报告作为 Track 12 的数据披露账本很有价值：它对数据、可扩展对齐、SFT、RLHF、过滤和安全评估提供了有意义的阶段级表述，同时保留了底层数据和优化细节。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official system card describes GPT-4.5 as a research preview that scales pre-training further and uses new supervision techniques alongside supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), similar to methods used for GPT-4o. It says scalable alignment techniques enable training with data derived from smaller models.

The report also says pre-training and post-training use diverse public data, proprietary data from partnerships, and custom in-house datasets. It therefore exposes broad stages and source classes, but no records or formal feedback contract. For this card, SFT and RLHF are method-family disclosures, not evidence of released pairwise preferences, scalar rewards, process supervision, or a reproducible recipe.

官方系统卡将 GPT-4.5 描述为进一步扩大预训练规模的研究预览版，并称其使用了新型监督技术以及与 GPT-4o 类似的监督微调（SFT）和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）。报告称可扩展对齐技术使得可使用来自较小模型的数据进行训练。

报告还称预训练和后训练使用了多样化的公开数据、合作伙伴提供的专有数据和定制内部数据。因此它公开了宽泛阶段与来源类别，却未公开记录或正式反馈契约。对于本卡，SFT 和 RLHF 是方法家族披露，而不是已发布成对偏好、标量奖励、过程监督或可复现配方的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report names three broad source classes—public data, proprietary partnership data, and custom in-house datasets—for pre-training and post-training. It also reports rigorous filtering, reduced processing of personal information, and use of the Moderation API plus safety classifiers to prevent harmful or sensitive content. Dataset names, manifests, weights, counts, dates, versions, rights, filter rules, thresholds, error rates, rejected examples, and yields are not provided.

OpenAI reports SFT, RLHF, and new supervision techniques, including scalable alignment data derived from smaller models. It also says GPT-4.5 inherited earlier refusal-behavior training and moderation-model use, and that instruction-hierarchy behavior was trained on collected system/user-message conflicts. The smaller-model identities, generated record types, conflict examples, label protocol, human/model proportions, preference units, reward model, verifier, objective, optimizer, schedules, rollouts, sampling, and checkpoints are unknown.

The card describes evaluations, not a training environment: examples include an autograder for refusal metrics, a headless Kali Linux environment with 16 rollouts per Cyber CTF challenge and pass@12, and hidden tests plus human-written prompts/tests/hints for an OpenAI PR evaluation. These do not establish post-training rewards or verifiers.

报告为预训练和后训练点名了三类宽泛来源：公开数据、合作伙伴专有数据和定制内部数据。它还报告了严格过滤、减少处理个人信息，以及使用 Moderation API 和安全分类器防止有害或敏感内容。数据集名称、清单、权重、数量、日期、版本、权利、过滤规则、阈值、错误率、被拒绝样本和产出均未提供。

OpenAI 报告了 SFT、RLHF 和新监督技术，包括来自较小模型的可扩展对齐数据。它还称 GPT-4.5 继承了早先的拒答行为训练和 moderation 模型使用，并针对收集的系统/用户消息冲突训练了 instruction hierarchy 行为。较小模型的身份、生成记录类型、冲突示例、标注协议、人类/模型比例、偏好单元、奖励模型、验证器、目标、优化器、日程、rollout、采样和检查点均为未知。

该卡描述的是评测，而不是训练环境：例如，拒答指标的自动评分器；每个 Cyber CTF 挑战 16 次 rollout、以 pass@12 计分的无头 Kali Linux 环境；以及 OpenAI PR 评测中的隐藏测试和人工编写的提示词/测试/提示。这些都不能确立后训练奖励或验证器。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official report directly supports the named source categories, the small-model-derived alignment statement, SFT/RLHF/new-supervision wording, filtering and safety-classifier statements, and the selected evaluation contracts. It rates the overall Preparedness risk as medium, with CBRN and persuasion medium and cybersecurity and model autonomy low.

The report also qualifies interpretation: production performance can vary with system updates, parameters, system-level instructions, and other factors; Preparedness evaluations are described as lower bounds, and bootstrap confidence intervals can understate uncertainty on small data. In a multimodal refusal evaluation, it reports GPT-4.5 not_overrefuse of 0.31 versus 0.48 for GPT-4o, noting greater overrefusal than comparison models.

No official training, post-training, preference, safety-training, evaluation-record, code, or model-weight release is linked by the accepted sources. The system card is evidence of disclosure, not a release of the underlying artifacts.

官方报告直接支持被点名的来源类别、来自小模型的对齐表述、SFT/RLHF/新监督措辞、过滤和安全分类器表述，以及选定的评测契约。它将总体 Preparedness 风险定为中等，其中 CBRN 和说服为中等，网络安全和模型自主性为低。

报告还对解释作出限定：生产性能会随系统更新、参数、系统提示词和其他因素变化；Preparedness 评测被描述为下界，且 bootstrap 置信区间在小数据集上可能低估不确定性。在多模态拒答评测中，它报告 GPT-4.5 的 not_overrefuse 为 0.31，而 GPT-4o 为 0.48，并指出 GPT-4.5 比比较模型更容易过度拒答。

已接受来源没有链接任何官方训练、后训练、偏好、安全训练、评测记录、代码或模型权重发布。系统卡是披露的证据，而不是底层工件的发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The useful contribution is the combination of stage-level disclosures with unusually concrete examples of evaluation contracts. Readers can see both what OpenAI names about post-training—SFT, RLHF, new supervision, smaller-model-derived alignment data, and safety training—and what remains withheld.

The evaluation details sharpen, rather than close, the disclosure boundary. An autograder, hidden unit tests, or a fixed CTF rollout protocol are evidence about evaluation design; they cannot be promoted into a disclosed training reward, verifier, environment, or data pipeline.

其有用贡献在于，将阶段级披露与异常具体的评测契约示例结合起来。读者既能看到 OpenAI 对后训练点名了什么——SFT、RLHF、新监督、来自小模型的对齐数据和安全训练——也能看到哪些信息仍被保留。

这些评测细节强化而非消除了披露边界。自动评分器、隐藏单元测试或固定的 CTF rollout 协议是关于评测设计的证据；它们不能被拔高为已披露的训练奖励、验证器、环境或数据流水线。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Broad source categories do not establish provenance, data mixture, reuse rights, benchmark overlap, or a source-to-record ledger. The report does not release SFT examples, smaller-model outputs, preference records, rationale/process annotations, safety-training conflicts, prompts, filters, or data splits. Its quality/privacy/safety filtering must not be called a decontamination procedure.

RLHF should not be expanded into an assumed pairwise or scalar reward contract. Feedback unit, rater protocol, reward/verifier implementation, calibration, aggregation, terminal predicate, objective, optimizer, sampling, rollout budget, temperature, schedules, and checkpoint allocation are undisclosed. The selected autograders and harnesses belong to evaluation unless the report states otherwise.

Scores remain conditional on configuration and uncertain under the report's own caveats. The system card offers no official arXiv record, DOI, code, data, weights, or verified BibTeX entry for GPT-4.5.

宽泛来源类别不能确立数据来源、数据混合、复用权利、基准重叠或来源到记录的账本。报告未发布 SFT 样例、较小模型输出、偏好记录、推理/过程标注、安全训练冲突、提示词、过滤规则或数据划分。其质量/隐私/安全过滤不能被称为去污染程序。

RLHF 不应被扩展为假定的成对偏好或标量奖励契约。反馈单元、评分者协议、奖励/验证器实现、校准、聚合、终止条件、目标、优化器、采样、rollout 预算、温度、日程和检查点分配均未披露。除非报告另有说明，所述自动评分器和评测工具链都属于评测。

分数仍取决于配置，并受报告自身所述不确定性限制。该系统卡没有提供 GPT-4.5 的官方 arXiv 记录、DOI、代码、数据、权重或已验证 BibTeX 条目。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card to separate report-level process disclosure from reusable training evidence. It is particularly useful for checking whether a claim about RLHF, small-model-derived alignment, filtering, or a safety evaluation has enough supporting artifacts to count as a data, feedback, or verification contract.

The missing ledger identifies priorities for future audit: manifests and rights; SFT, new-supervision, and RLHF schemas; teacher/reward/verifier specifications; filters and rejection yields; rollout and optimization logs; train/evaluation splits; decontamination; and releaseable evaluation environments and records.

可使用本卡将报告级流程披露与可复用训练证据区分开来。它尤其适合检查关于 RLHF、来自小模型的对齐、过滤或安全评测的主张，是否拥有足够的支持工件，能够构成数据、反馈或验证契约。

缺失账本指出了未来审计的优先项：清单与权利；SFT、新监督和 RLHF 的模式；教师/奖励/验证器规格；过滤和拒绝产出；rollout 与优化日志；训练/评测划分；去污染；以及可发布的评测环境和记录。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep broad public, partnership, and in-house data categories separate from a source manifest or rights ledger.
  • Treat SFT, RLHF, new supervision, and smaller-model-derived alignment as high-level method statements, not a released feedback or reward contract.
  • The reported CTF harness, autograder, and hidden tests are evaluation evidence, not evidence of post-training rewards or environments.
  • Preserve the report's configuration and uncertainty caveats, including the disclosed multimodal overrefusal result.

• 将宽泛的公开、合作伙伴和内部数据类别，与来源清单或权利账本区分开来。
  • 将 SFT、RLHF、新监督和来自小模型的对齐视为高层方法表述，而不是已发布的反馈或奖励契约。
  • 报告的 CTF 工具链、自动评分器和隐藏测试是评测证据，而不是后训练奖励或环境的证据。
  • 保留报告关于配置与不确定性的限定，包括已披露的多模态过度拒答结果。
